The '''Tyrusia system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the creatures known as [[Tyrusian butterfly-bird]]s<ref name="MedStar" /> and [[Tyrusian mangler]]s<ref name="ShadowHunter" /> and was also the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> [[Tyrusian red ale]].<ref name="MedStar" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tyrusia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
